author: Natalya F
text: A must-have for long trips when there's no decent, safe food on the road. Managed to cook buckwheat, spaghetti, and packet soup on the go using the steam setting — it took anywhere from half an hour to an hour and a half. Couldn't tell when it was done, ruined some dumplings and got mush out of them. Need to read up on cooking specific dishes; cooking in the car takes longer and the timing is inconsistent — not like on a gas stove. Waited a long time for it to boil, stopped to check, then waited again for it to be ready. The cooker sat at the front passenger's feet; at some point the spaghetti boiled over and water started spilling slightly through the gap at the top — had to unplug quickly. Don't regret the purchase — very useful for anyone with GI issues who can't just snack on sandwiches.
